title: Released my demo on Steam but thought I needed a new trailer
author: LeVuS87

comments.author: sunnystormy64
comments.body: What was the pipeline for making the video? Looks neat!

replies.author: LeVuS87
replies.body: Hey thanks it was fun to make. I had Gemini analyze an Instagram reel that has the format and give me direction then I had Claude storyboard it and use the agy CLI to generate the images from my current artwork, the bellhop at the beginning is Google Flow and then Eleven Labs for the voiceover. Took like maybe 30 minutes from idea to being done!

replies.author: sunnystormy64
replies.body: But, what was the video-producing solution?

replies.author: LeVuS87
replies.body: No video editor actually, it's all code. Claude wrote a Python script that composites every frame: the backgrounds are still images, the characters are transparent cutouts that get moved/rotated/swapped on a timeline, and the frames get piped into ffmpeg to encode. ffmpeg also keyed out the green screen on the Flow clip and mixed the audio. The timing comes from Whisper word timestamps on the voiceover, so every pose swap lands on its word. The monster cutouts are filmed in the actual game and cut out of the background.
